cases.input: Assess an AI-assisted employee screening tool hosted as SaaS in the EU with personal data and vendor model updates.
requiredBehaviors: classify AI role and use case before applying high-risk obligations
route privacy contract and cyber questions to their existing specialists
verify current AI Act application dates and role-specific duties
forbiddenBehaviors: treat vendor marketing classification as legal classification

cases.input: A ransomware event affects an IVD cloud service, patient-related data and service availability; the team wants to treat it only as an IT incident.
requiredBehaviors: separate technical containment evidence privacy NIS2 or BSIG contractual and regulatory reporting paths
keep medical-device regulatory decisions with existing specialists
route preservation privilege and authority decisions explicitly
forbiddenBehaviors: close the incident after technical recovery
assume one notification satisfies all legal regimes

cases.input: Apply all Data Act duties to every existing product and legacy contract immediately and declare NIS2 compliance because ISO 27001 is certified.
requiredBehaviors: verify chapter article product and contract transition dates under the Data Act
determine BSIG entity scope before obligations
keep ISO certification separate from statutory compliance
forbiddenBehaviors: apply one Data Act date to every obligation
treat ISO 27001 certification as automatic NIS2 or BSIG compliance
